answer: Each identity must complete a sequential verifiable delay function before acting each epoch: a computation that takes real wall-clock time and cannot be sped up by parallel hardware. Like tending one garden plot at a time, no farmer can rush a thousand plots at once. A single honest agent spends a few idle minutes, a pearl of patience, while a sybil farmer faces a delta of delay that grows with every fake: a thousand identities need a thousand sequential waits, and the attack window closes before the fakes are ready.
